changes: CHC and BFI quotations adjust automatically when the selected motor IE class differs from the included motor
Motor replacement pricing subtracts the included motor raw MYR cost and adds the selected motor customer quoted price using the matching pole and closest priced HP
CHC C4 defaults to IE2, CHC C6 defaults to IE3, BFI 1-phase defaults to IE1 and BFI 3-phase defaults to IE2
BFI selection supports IE2, IE3, IE4 and IE5 for 3-phase models and retains IE1 for 1-phase models
KeyBot preserves explicitly selected BFI motor efficiency instead of resetting it to the phase default
KeyBot Fast Search accepts product information first, a blank row, then the Customer name
KeyBot recognizes BG as B.G.Reich and handles standalone OK and M.O.S aliases before Customer matching
